title: server crates: decide testkit for mail-server canonical
description: JMAP-z4z0.6 added a testkit feature (ConformanceBackend + chat_backend_conformance! macro) to jmap-chat-server, a non-canonical server crate, per Mark's chinwag-nuqe.25 decision. AGENTS.md Canonical Templates asks for a canonical-first change or a sweep bead. Decision needed: (a) chat-only, record the divergence in AGENTS.md; (b) add the same testkit shape to jmap-mail-server and mirror to siblings. Recommendation: (a) until a downstream backend for another extension needs it (YAGNI).
